This '''customs officer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and member of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction who worked in [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He went to inspect the arrival of [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]] by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], however the [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual delivering the [[Tea/Legends|tea]], [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]], had brought [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]-laced product to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] was [[Credit ingot/Legends|bribed]] by Tee Va and left him to his business. Later he went back to "inspect" the next shipment only to be bribed again, during which [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had secretly discovered what was going on.

==Behind the scenes==
The customs officer has a crest on his right shoulder written in [[Mandalorian (writing system)/Legends|''Mandalorian'']].
